rules.utility: Evergy Kansas Central, Inc. and Evergy Metro, Inc. (Evergy Kansas Metro)
rules.threshold_text: 75 MW: a new customer with a peak load of 75 MW or greater, or an existing customer expanding by 75 MW or greater
rules.contract_term: 12 years plus an optional load ramp of up to five years (up to 17 years in all); then automatic five-year extensions
rules.collateral: Two years of Minimum Monthly Bills, as calculated by Evergy, under creditworthiness standards
rules.exit_fee: 36 months' advance notice to terminate early, and an exit fee of the Minimum Monthly Bill times the months remaining in the term, or 12 months, whichever is greater; with less than 36 months' notice, the exit fee plus two times the Minimum Monthly Bill times the months short of 36. Capacity may be reduced by the lower of 25 MW or 10 percent of contract capacity

rules.utility: Evergy Kansas Central, Inc. and Evergy Metro, Inc. (Evergy Kansas Metro)
Sunflower Electric Power Corporation and its seven member utilities (central and western Kansas)
Evergy Metro, Inc. d/b/a Evergy Missouri Metro
rules.collateral: Two years of Minimum Monthly Bills (held); a customer that, with any Guarantor, meets credit rating and liquidity tests is exempt from 60, 50, 40 or 25 percent of it, those discounts capped at $175 million, $150 million, $125 million and $75 million; provided at the time of executing the LLPS Service Agreement

rules.utility: Evergy Metro, Inc. d/b/a Evergy Missouri Metro
rules.threshold_text: Loads expected to be greater than 25 MW
rules.collateral: A refundable deposit of $200,000 with the Letter of Agreement, to offset project planning costs; if costs exceed it, an additional refundable deposit of $200,000; further refundable deposits (no amount stated) so that the customer pays all project planning costs; unused initial deposit funds refunded without interest; projects the Company designates as serving the community interest may be prioritized and may not be required to submit a deposit; substation or transmission extensions are paid in full by the customer (SPP network upgrades excluded)
rules.study_timeline: No study duration published. Customers are queued by the date they gave the required information and deposit; the Company works on advanced study and scoping for up to four projects at a time; once an Initial Projects Agreement is complete the details go to SPP for review; completed plans are valid for six months

rules.utility: The Empire District Electric Company d/b/a Liberty (Empire Electric)

rules.state: ND, SD, MT, WY and other member states

rules.contract_term: Long-term contract commitments are part of the proposal; no term published in the document read

rules.threshold_text: 75 MW of Computational load (data centers, cryptocurrency mining) at a single facility, or multiple Computational loads in aggregate treated as a single facility
rules.contract_term: Initial Contract Term from execution until 18 years from the inception of the Ramp Period (Ramp Period not over five years); then annual renewals until either party gives notice at least five years before the end of the term
rules.collateral: 24 times the customer's previous maximum monthly non-fuel bill based on the last Step in Schedule 1, provided within a number of days left blank in the form; recomputed annually in the full operations period and updated if 10% greater
rules.exit_fee: Termination Fee on early termination (or three months' non-payment): the future minimum payments for the remaining Ramp Period, Full Operations Period and the five-year notice period, due within 90 days

rules.threshold_text: Aggregated Service of 75 MW or more of Peak Contracted Load (transmission voltage, 69 kV and above, delivery points within a 2.5-mile radius under common ownership or control), and Peak Contracted Load Growth of 75 MW or more after 25 September 2026
rules.contract_term: Minimum initial term of 15 years at full Peak Contracted Load, any ramp period added; existing loads may get up to 10 years of credit for prior continuous service; automatic five-year renewal terms unless 24 months' written notice
rules.collateral: Both an irrevocable letter of credit of at least three months' minimum bills (at the highest Peak Contracted Load in the ESA) and a guaranty of at least five years of minimum bill payments and no more than the exit fee; a qualified guarantor needs a tangible net worth of at least 500 million dollars and an investment grade rating; a customer without a creditworthy guarantor posts a letter of credit instead; letters of credit from banks rated at least A- (S&P) or A3 (Moody's); security posted within 30 days of the ESA or of the Company's notice
rules.exit_fee: Minimum bill payments after termination for the lesser of 15 years or the remaining initial or renewal term (the 15 years counting the 24-month notice period plus 13 years of payments after termination)

laws.bill: S.B. 98 (2025 Session Laws of Kansas, Chapter 124)
laws.title: An Act concerning data centers; relating to economic development; providing a sales tax exemption for the construction or remodeling of a qualified data center in Kansas
To repeal section 393.130, RSMo, and to enact in lieu thereof two new sections relating to the regulation of large load electric customers.
To repeal sections ... RSMo, and to enact in lieu thereof thirty-two new sections relating to utilities
Large Load Customer Regulation Act (A BILL FOR AN ACT relating to electricity)
An Act to protect residents from increased utility costs and utility shortages caused by data centers and clarify authority to regulate data centers.
